effect.name: GM Warpchroma
effect.desc: Warps the red, green and blue channels through the same field by three different amounts, so the colour separation follows the deformation instead of being a fixed offset - which is what separates this from a plain chromatic aberration. Six warp fields: a divergence-free noise curl that swirls rather than squashes, a crossed wave pair, a twist, a bulge, a damped ripple and a radial zoom. On top of the per-channel split there is a dispersion term that grows the separation with distance from a movable centre, a directional and a rotational split mode, a falloff mask, octave control, evolution and clamp/mirror/wrap sampling. Layer space throughout.
